description: This source file defines the class WorkEffortContentWrapper, which implements the ContentWrapper interface. The class provides methods to retrieve and render content related to work efforts, including fetching content by type, content IDs, and rendering content as text with caching support. It manages content retrieval logic and interacts with content entities, cache, and rendering utilities within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WorkEffortContentWrapper
classes.description: Implements the ContentWrapper interface to provide content retrieval and rendering functionalities for work efforts within the OFBiz framework. It manages cache, content fetching by type, ID, and description, and content rendering with support for different encoders.
